title: Strata Staff Joins the Canadian Condominium Institute (CCI) British Columbia Chapter
summary: Strata Staff joins the Canadian Condominium Institute (CCI) British Columbia Chapter.
body:
Strata Staff is proud to be a new member of the Canadian Condominium Institute (CCI) British Columbia Chapter, reflecting our commitment to supporting condominium and strata management professionals across Canada through reliable offshore solutions.
Joining CCI British Columbia gives us opportunities to connect with industry leaders and improve operational efficiency, reduce workload pressure and enhance client service for condominium and strata management teams.
The membership strengthens our role as a trusted offshoring business solutions partner that understands the Canadian condominium and strata industry, helping management companies focus on their core operations.

title: Strata Staff Joins SCA South Australia
summary: Strata Staff is now a corporate member of the Strata Community Association South Australia (SCA SA).
body:
We’re proud to announce that Strata Staff is now a corporate member of the Strata Community Association South Australia (SCA SA).
As a company delivering offshore staffing solutions for strata and property professionals, we believe industry alignment is key to long-term success — for our clients and the communities they serve.
With membership in both the New South Wales and South Australia chapters of the Strata Community Association, we are deepening our support for strata businesses across regions, reinforcing our dedication to quality, trust and collaboration, and strengthening our connection to the evolving needs of the strata sector.
Our team helps strata businesses scale efficiently and sustainably through reliable offshore support that reflects local standards, best practices and client expectations.
We look forward to contributing to the SCA community as a trusted partner for the growing needs of the strata sector.

title: Strata Staff Unveils Its Upgraded Marisol Office
summary: Our Marisol Office upgrade creates a more comfortable, productive environment for our team and clients.
body:
We’ve Upgraded Our Space.
We have upgraded our Marisol Office to create a more comfortable, productive environment for our team and visiting clients.
Here's What's New for Visiting Clients:
Full Concierge Support
We arrange accommodation and transport bookings, plus a dedicated company vehicle for local travel.
Exclusive Access to Our New Client Lounge
Our newly built client lounge is designed for comfort, focused work and meetings.
Meeting Room Access
Our meeting rooms are available for team training sessions, coaching discussions or 1-on-1s.
Safe and Secure Environment
Our offices have 24/7 building security and a secure key-door lock system.
Planning a visit?
For enquiries or to schedule a visit, contact Patty at patty@stratastaffglobal.com

title: We are a Trusted SCA Member
summary: Strata Staff is now an official corporate member of the Strata Community Association NSW — among the first offshore staffing firms to receive this recognition.
body:
Strata Staff is now an official corporate member of the Strata Community Association NSW!
We are proud to be the first offshoring company to join the association, reinforcing our commitment to delivering service and value to the strata industry.
Membership brings confidence to our clients, knowing we are aligned with an organization that upholds strong industry standards and promotes best practices.
